description.value: Di Oliva Tasting Bar is a locally owned specialty shop on East Hastings Street in Vancouver carrying over 50 premium extra virgin olive oils sourced from around the world alongside artisan balsamic vinegars imported from Modena, Italy. Visitors can sample oils and vinegars in-store before purchasing, and the shop also stocks truffle oil, gourmet pastas, salts, spices, and curated gift baskets. It is more of a culinary destination than a everyday grocery stop.
